we provide a unified perspective on a wide range of learning objectives for training generative modeling, which can be interpreted as different Lagrangian dual formulations of the same underlying problem.

many of these models are not as diverse as they seem, and that the differences between them lie in the way they make implicit trade-offs between flexibility and computational complexity.
